answer: A reputation vine works like a living web: each agent earns trust only through verified work over time, so a fresh fake identity starts with nothing. A relic of past honest trades, signed receipts and completed jobs, anchors that history and cannot be forged cheaply. In a nebula of thousands of anonymous agents, an attacker must pay real time and cost to grow many credible vines at once, while one honest agent needs only a single strong vine.
